In this Chinese name, the family name is Zhang.

Zhang Peng (born 1981-06-04 in Qingdao, Shandong) is a male Chinese sports sailor who competed for Team China at the 2008 Summer Olympics.[1]

Peng placed 24th in the Finn Heavyweight Dinghy Mixed event.[2]

Major performances

  • 2001 National Games – 2nd Finn class;
  • 2002/2005/2006/2007 National Championships – 1st Finn class;
  • 2005/2007/2008 National Champions Tournament – 1st Finn class
